notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP fetch only (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome + bs4/lxml). robots.txt (User-agent: * / Disallow: */pages/configurator?*=*) does not block fetch tools or Chrome; homepage and all collection pages returned 200 on first request, no blocks encountered, so tiers (b)/(c) were not needed. TREE: Built from union of the site's mobile mega-menu (Shop > Kids/Outdoor Living/Accessories/Furniture/Sofas/Lighting/Kitchen/Textiles/Rugs/Certified Products/Spare Parts, each with its own flyout sub-links) and sitemap_collections_1.xml (186 collection URLs, cross-checked - no additional Textile/Storage nodes found beyond the nav). Site is Shopify (fermliving.myshopify.com backend). QTY: For each candidate collection, paginated /collections/<slug>/products.json?limit=250 and counted unique product ids until an empty page (this is the exhaustive 'count unique product cards' method since no page displays an explicit 'N products' total). Cross-verified on the Cushions collection against HTML-rendered pagination (89 unique /products/ links vs 88 via products.json); the 1-item discrepancy was a recurring '/products/gift-card' promo link injected on every collection page (confirmed via set-diff), so the products.json count was treated as authoritative for all rows. Parent collections /collections/textiles (208) and /collections/rugs (106) were NOT recorded per the parent-URL rule since both have valid, deeper subcategories that were recorded instead. EXCLUDED nodes and why: Wallpaper/Kids Wallpaper (paper wall covering, not textile), Mirrors/Hooks and Holders/Vases/Plant Pots/Plant Boxes/Candles/Candleholders (Decorative Accessories boundary), Kitchen tableware (Glasses/Cups/Carafes/Plates/Bowls/Serveware/Kitchen Tools, all Kitchen & Dining), Lighting (all sub-nodes), Furniture/Sofas/Chairs/Tables/Stools/Poufs/Daybeds/Outdoor Furniture/Outdoor Seating/Outdoor Tables/Outdoor Pots (Furniture boundary), Kids Toys/Baby Objects/Kids Furniture/Kids Lamps/Kids Accessories (non-textile/non-storage Kids nodes), Gift Sets/Bestsellers/News/Certified Products/Spare Parts/sale-* filters/'picnic' curated collection (View-All/promotional/curated cross-category collections, not genuine category nodes), 'can-lis-upholstery-fabric' (specific sofa/pouf modules upholstered in one fabric - Furniture product, not a textile category), 'Fabric Samples' (fabric-samples, 61 items) excluded as swatch/preview products for choosing upholstery fabric, not a standalone home-textile product line. STORAGE-specific exclusions: 'Shelves' (/collections/shelves, 69 items) inspected by product title - almost entirely furniture pieces (Kona Bookcase, Lager Bedside Table, Curvature Wall Table, Bon Hallway Cabinet, wall shelves) sitting under the Furniture nav flyout, not primarily storage/organization - left to the Furniture task. 'Small Storage' (/collections/small-storage, 150 items) inspected by product title - despite its name, the large majority (~120/150) are decorative small objects (bowls, centrepieces, trays, soap dishes, toothbrush holders, pencil holders, cake stands, fireplace tools) that are explicitly non-Storage per the Decorative-vs-Storage boundary; only a minority are genuine boxes/organisers with no separate URL to isolate them, so the whole node was excluded rather than force a contaminated qty. INCLUDED-WITH-CAVEAT nodes (flagged, not excluded, because the genuine-purpose majority clearly dominates and no cleaner URL exists): 'Outdoor Textiles' (39) - product-title inspection found ~34/39 genuine outdoor textiles (cushions, cushion covers, quilted mattresses, folding mats, rugs, runners) plus 5 stray non-textile items (a garden tote/picnic bags, a garden apron, one 'Bark Garden Wall Storage'); recorded as Textile at MEDIUM confidence with the full page qty since the site provides no separate URL to split them. 'Kids Storage' (50) and 'Storage' (107) both sit under non-Storage nav sections (Kids and Furniture respectively) but are the site's own explicitly-named Storage collections; nearly every product in both (baskets, bins, boxes, wall pockets, storage bags, plus storage-furniture hybrids such as sideboards/bookcases/dressers/wall cabinets/cupboards) is storage-purpose, so both were recorded as Storage at MEDIUM confidence per the 'explicit site categorization' rule (storage.md S21/S9), noting the furniture-form hybrids may also legitimately appear in the separate Furniture extraction task. 'Bags and Baskets' (20) is a genuinely mixed collection (~13/20 laundry/storage baskets and bins vs ~7/20 personal-carry tote/weekend/picnic bags and a pouch); recorded as Storage at LOW confidence with a MANUAL REVIEW flag since storage items are the numeric majority but the page qty is not purely storage and there is no separate basket-only URL.
